_comment: IteratedUltimatumGame locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the action tokens [Offer: $X] / [Accept] / [Reject]. Keep the '$' currency symbol and all numbers as-is.

_slots.{pool}: Amount of money available each round (a number)
_slots.{keep}: The amount the proposer keeps (a number)
_slots.{proposer_gain}: Money the proposer gained this round (a number)
_slots.{responder_gain}: Money the responder gained this round (a number)
_slots.{total}: Each player's tied final total (a number)

player_prompt.intro:
Tzes Player {player_id}, giogande {num_rounds} turnos de Iterated Ultimatum Game.
Tenes ${pool} a spartzire pro custu turnu tra tze e Player {other_id}.

Propositore:
  - Fae un'oferta: [Offer: $X] (0 <= X <= pool)
  - Si est aceta → Tu otzienis $(pool - X), s'àteru giocadore otzienit $X
  - Si est refudada → Ambos duos otzienint $0
  - Esèmpiu: [Offer: $3]  o  'Penzu chi custa siat giusta. [Offer: $5]'

Responder:
  - Decida s'oferta cun [Accept] o [Reject]
  - Esèmpiu: 'Custu parìt razu. [Accept]'
            'Tropu inzustu. [Reject]'

round.begins:
--- Turnu {round_number} cumintzat! ---
Giocadore {proposer_id} est propositore, Giocadore {responder_id} est responder.
round.accepted: Giocadore {responder_id} at aceta! Turnu {round_number} guadagnos: Giocadore {proposer_id} +${proposer_gain}, Giocadore {responder_id} +${responder_gain}. Noas totales: Giocadore 0: ${total_0}, Giocadore 1: ${total_1}.
round.rejected: Giocadore {responder_id} at refudadu s'oferta! Turnu {round_number} guadagnos: Ambos duos giogadores +$0. Totales abarrant: Giocadore 0: ${total_0}, Giocadore 1: ${total_1}.

invalid_move.no_offer_format: Su proponente depet fàghere un'oferta impreende su formadu [Offer: $X].
invalid_move.bad_integer: S'importu de s'oferta depet èssere unu nùmeru intreu vàlidu.
invalid_move.no_current_offer: Non b'at peruna oferta atuale pro rispòndere.
invalid_move.accept_or_reject: Responder deve tzèrerer EITHER [Accept] o [Reject] s'oferta.

outcome.win: Giocadore {winner} at winnings cun ${winner_total} totale vs Giocadore {loser} de ${loser_total}.
outcome.draw: Parigi! Ambos giogadores ant acabadu cun ${total} totale.
